metadata.description: Enterprise interaction and contraindication dataset for Indian Pharmacopoeia drugs.

interactsWith.warning: Itraconazole is a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor, significantly increasing atorvastatin levels and the risk of severe muscle toxicity (myopathy/rhabdomyolysis).

contraindications.warning: Itraconazole has negative inotropic effects and can exacerbate or trigger congestive heart failure.

interactsWith.warning: Prolonged daily use of paracetamol may increase the anticoagulant effect of warfarin.
Ibuprofen may competitively inhibit the antiplatelet effect of low-dose aspirin.

contraindications.warning: Increased risk of gastrointestinal bleeding and mucosal damage.
